pinned_revision_note: repo HEAD at pre-registration time; dirty=true from untracked sibling-experiment files elsewhere in the tree (none inside this experiment directory). Per CODEX.md/SUBAGENT_BRIEF.md, captures are gated on the authored blob hashes below, not on live HEAD -- the orchestrator commits other experiments continuously and HEAD moving is not contamination.

target.a18_pro_claim: NONE -- this experiment makes no A18 Pro/G17P claim anywhere

toolchain.agxisa_py: tools/agx-isa/agxisa.py (read-only, invoked as subprocess for tokenize only)

authored_blob_hashes_sha256.kernels/deep/*: 27 files, one per (family,depth); full listing + hashes emitted by harness/run.py's blob_hashes() into every raw/*.nongated.jsonl _meta record

nongated_fields: out_nongated (gputime_ns, stderr_tail, compile logs, timed_out, rc)
raw_record_schema.gate_rule: raw/<run_id>.jsonl must be byte-identical (field-for-field, excluding run_id/seq) between run01 and run02, since every case in this matrix is a deterministic function of (fixed hardware, fixed compiled bytes, fixed splice). raw/<run_id>.nongated.jsonl is explicitly NOT gated and is expected to differ (gputime_ns, wall clock).

environment.scratch_policy: all temp/compile/dispatch artifacts under work/ inside this experiment directory; nothing written outside the repo
